cards.title: Nmap
cards.description_short: Powerful network discovery and port scanning tool
cards.description_long: Nmap (Network Mapper) is one of the most widely used tools for network discovery and security auditing. It can detect live hosts, scan ports, identify services and operating systems, and run vulnerability detection scripts.

cards.title: ZMap
cards.description_long: ZMap is designed for extremely fast scanning of large networks and even the entire IPv4 address space. It is commonly used for large-scale research and security analysis.

cards.title: Netdiscover
cards.description_short: Discover devices on a local network
cards.description_long: Netdiscover is a network reconnaissance tool used to discover live hosts in a local network. It uses ARP requests to identify devices and their IP/MAC addresses.

cards.title: Angry IP Scanner
cards.description_short: Fast graphical IP and port scanner
cards.description_long: Angry IP Scanner is a lightweight, cross-platform network scanner with a graphical interface. It scans IP ranges to detect live hosts, open ports, and basic network information.
